work.summary: Two weeks summer school on effective field theory approaches in GW physics. Presented a poster on 'EFT approaches in diboson production' pertaining to methodological overlap of EFT techniques.

work.organization: Gravitational Wave Open Data Workshop; ICTS-TIFR
work.summary: Facilitated a theoretical and demonstration session on "Demonstrating chaos with double pendulum and magnetic pendulum systems". Facilitated laboratorys essions for 53 undergradute students participating from all over India.

highlights: I completed my M.Sc. Physics degree here with a thesis in Experimental High Energy Physics group under the guidance of Prof. Saurabh Sandilya. I worked on Muon Scattering Tomography technique for non-destructive testing of materials with high and moderate atomic numbers.

I completed my B.Sc. Physics degree with a thesis in theoretical particle physics under the guidance of Prof. K. Sridhar. I worked on a review of CP violation in K and B meson systems and the study of strangeness oscillations.

publications.name: A statistical investigation of radio-loudness in SDSS DR16Q quasars using ML-based classification and physical feature analysis
publications.summary: In this work we explored the role of logistic regression on high dimensional multiwavelength SDSS DR16Q dataset for classifying quasars as radio-loud or radio-quiet. We connected the classification task to physical features of quasars to comment upon features holding discrimination power.
